title: A chord is 3+ notes played together.
caption: Your Em chord rings E, G and B at the same time.

title: Your six strings are E, A, D, G, B, E.
caption: Thick to thin. Eddie Ate Dynamite, Good Bye Eddie.

title: Each fret raises a note by one half step.
caption: Walk up the low E string: E, F, F sharp, G.

title: Your two E strings are the same note.
caption: They sit two octaves apart, so they ring together cleanly.

title: One note changes major into minor.
caption: Am has a C. Lift it to C sharp and you have A major.

title: The root is the note a chord is named after.
caption: In a D chord, start your strum on the open D string.

title: A bar is a small box of beats.
caption: Most songs here count four beats, then start the next bar.

title: Down strums land on the beat, up strums between.
caption: Keep your hand moving, even when it doesn't touch the strings.
